full_name: Clarissa Tossin | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
bio: Clarissa Tossin is an interdisciplinary artist based in Los Angeles, California. Using installation, video, performance, sculpture, and photography, she investigates material cultural production and the ways in which it simultaneously represents the hybridization of global cultures and the persistence of difference.
